title: Information Gathering And Conclusion System
mission: Turn public-source leads into useful, evidence-bounded conclusions that help readers understand power, policy, money, identity, institutions, wrongdoing, safeguarding failures, missing records and convergence routes without confusing speculation or association for proof.

pipeline.title: Collect
pipeline.rule: Gather source links, official pages, filings, public records, archives, reader leads, card forum submissions and daily public drops while preserving the original source and metadata.

pipeline.title: Classify
pipeline.rule: Tag each item by lane, actor, jurisdiction, date, evidence level, legal status, source class, affected dossiers, decks, clocks and missing records.

pipeline.title: Grade Evidence
pipeline.rule: Separate official records, primary documents, final adjudication, charges, reliable reporting, documented association, commentary, inference, speculation, contradiction and unsupported claims.

pipeline.title: Cross-check
pipeline.rule: Compare against counter-sources, corrections, appeals, acquittals, dismissals, older records, duplicate claims, outdated pages, chronology problems, identity conflicts and alternative explanations.

pipeline.title: Connect
pipeline.rule: Resolve entities and route source material to every affected person, family, company, institution, case, clock, card, policy, timeline, relationship, report and alert.

pipeline.title: Conclude
pipeline.rule: Explain what was found, why it matters, which lanes apply, the mechanism, effect on each lane, wider direction, alternative explanation, limitation, evidence strength, confidence, sources and next questions.

pipeline.title: Publish
pipeline.rule: Propagate the approved conclusion through dossiers, Daily Watch, Daily Brief, Live Intel, cards, graphs, clocks, search, reports, downloads, alerts and the public change log.

pipeline.title: Review
pipeline.rule: Re-check stale conclusions, process reader corrections and right of reply, preserve version history and downgrade, correct, disprove, archive or reopen items when the evidence changes.

evidenceLevels.label: Lead
evidenceLevels.meaning: Interesting source or claim, not enough to conclude.

evidenceLevels.label: Documented mention or association
evidenceLevels.meaning: A visible communication, relationship, meeting, transaction, role or public claim is documented, but wrongdoing is not established.

evidenceLevels.label: Credible secondary evidence
evidenceLevels.meaning: Supported by reliable reporting or multiple credible secondary sources.

evidenceLevels.label: Primary source or implementation
evidenceLevels.meaning: Official page, filing, legislation, court record, contract, procurement, pilot, enforcement action, operational rollout or signed agreement.

evidenceLevels.label: Official finding or convergence
evidenceLevels.meaning: An official determination or documented connection between multiple systems, such as identity plus payments, health plus travel, or data plus public-service decisions.

evidenceLevels.label: Final adjudication or lock-in signal
evidenceLevels.meaning: A final judicial outcome, formal admission, or documented condition in which access becomes difficult to avoid, reverse or appeal.

conclusionTemplate: How it fits and the documented mechanism

dailyWatch.selectionRule: Select the entities most materially elevated by current source-linked evidence. Structural family relevance must be clearly distinguished from direct current evidence.
dailyWatch.publicationRule: Publish to the dedicated Daily Watch page, homepage, Daily Command Brief, Daily Brain Brief, Live Intel, search and weekly delta review.
dailyWatch.boundary: Selection means focused research priority, not guilt, accusation, hidden control or participation in another person’s wrongdoing.

propagationTargets: Daily Watch, Live Intel and briefs
claim ledger, corrections and version history
qualityRules: No [object Object] visible in public pages.
No internal author notes, debug text or prompt text visible to users.
No source link, no ledger entry.
No conclusion without an evidence boundary, counterpoint and falsifier.
No score movement without a dated source route affecting the exact measured variable.
No relationship entry presented as guilt, knowledge, motive or control beyond the documented mechanism.
No undefined use of the phrase the agenda.
No public child-crime flag without exact legal status, provenance and editorial review.
Every verified legal-status change propagates to all affected dossiers, cases, timelines, graphs, indexes, briefs and alerts.
Every public brief needs a plain-language meaning, next action and missing-record path.
Every Daily Watch slot must explain why today, how it fits, what it strengthens, what it points toward and what it does not prove.
